_comment: Secondary Atlas Vector Search index for the voyage-multimodal-3.5 comparison. Create in Atlas UI: Database > Search > Create Index > JSON Editor > Vector Search. Index name MUST match ATLAS_VECTOR_INDEX_MM (default 'vector_index_mm'). numDimensions must match MULTIMODAL_EMBED_DIM (voyage-multimodal-3.5 = 1024). Vectors are written client-side into the 'embeddingMultimodal' field.
